expectations: A memory states that Kestrel pages the on-call engineer through the PagerDuty service kestrel-primary.

items.memory: Kestrel pages the on-call engineer through the PagerDuty service `kestrel-primary`.
If the primary does not acknowledge within 15 minutes, the page escalates to the secondary on-call engineer.
Write the incident summary in the `#kestrel-incidents` channel before the shift ends.
